# Red Lobster

> > Red Lobster is a casual dining seafood restaurant chain with locations across the United States, offering fresh seafood dishes and a family-friendly dining experience.

Red Lobster operates hundreds of restaurant locations throughout the United States, providing customers with accessible seafood dining options. The website helps guests find nearby locations, view menus, and plan their visits to Red Lobster restaurants in their area.

## Key Topics

- Seafood restaurants
- Restaurant locations
- Casual dining
- Fresh seafood
- Family dining
- Menu offerings
- Location finder
- Restaurant hours
- Online ordering
- Reservations
- Cheddar Bay Biscuits
- Lobster dishes
- Shrimp specialties
- Crab offerings
- Seasonal promotions
